entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-worshipping planeswalker native to Tarkir, a Mardu warrior whose spark ignited when a dragon spirit's spell unleashed a fire dragon.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Sarkhan's home plane, where dragons had gone extinct before his birth until he changed history.

entities.name: The Mardu clan
entities.description: The clan in which Sarkhan gained status as a warrior.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker Sarkhan swore fealty to on Jund and who killed Ugin; Sarkhan found him villainous and undragonlike.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A long-dead spirit dragon whose death at Bolas's hands Sarkhan travelled back in time to prevent.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The Jeskai khan who aided Sarkhan at the cost of her life; she is alive again after the timeline change.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of the plane of Alara ruled by tyrannical hellkites and other dragons.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of which Jund is a shard.

events.summary: After a victory against a rival clan, a long-dead dragon's spirit whispers a spell into Sarkhan's mind and vanishes.
events.quote: The spirit of a long-dead dragon appeared to him, whispered a spell into his mind, and then vanished forever.

events.summary: A huge fire dragon bursts from Sarkhan's body and burns his men and his enemies to cinders, igniting his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: a huge dragon made of fire streaked out of Sarkhan's body and invaded the battle

events.summary: Sarkhan travels from plane to plane seeking a dragon to dedicate his life to, and on Jund declares fealty to Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Disillusioned by Bolas, Sarkhan falls into madness and is led back to Tarkir by a voice he believes is Ugin's.
events.quote: Disillusioned by his servitude to the villainous, conniving, woefully undragonlike Bolas, Sarkhan fell into madness.

events.summary: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, Sarkhan travels back through time to prevent Ugin's death at Bolas's hands.
events.quote: a way to travel back through time to the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands and prevent the spirit dragon from falling.

events.summary: Pulled back to the present, Sarkhan finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive.
events.quote: a world in which both Ugin and Narset were still alive.

events.summary: The Tarkir of Sarkhan's birth is gone, and Sarkhan is now a man never born, with his mind free of Bolas and Ugin.
events.quote: his mind is once again his own, free of the influences of both Bolas and Ugin.

relations.quote: gained status as a warrior in the Mardu clan

relations.note: He declared fealty to Bolas on Jund, later disillusioned.
relations.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: Ugin died at Bolas's hands before Sarkhan changed the past.
relations.quote: the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands

relations.note: She aided him at the cost of her life.
relations.quote: aided by the Jeskai khan Narset at the cost of her life
On Jund, a shard of the plane of Alara
